amendment_policy: Never edit after a new validation result is observed. Add a separately named amendment and versioned run instead.

backend.name: lmstudio
backend.artifact_hash_note: LM Studio /v1/models exposes model id but no artifact hash; this is a preregistered reproducibility caveat.

domain_reason: SQL has a deterministic read-only SQLite verifier, structured failure classes, no generated-code subprocess in the primary loop, and template-group isolated splits.

splits.search: first 10 ids from SQL manifest search, fixed before runs
splits.validation: first 10 ids from SQL manifest validation; evaluated only after each final genome is frozen
splits.held_out: all SQL held-out ids remain unopened
splits.transfer: first 10 MBPP validation ids; evaluate only if core finalists and infrastructure permit

method_notes.literature_inspired_baseline: Steering-only sequential propose/evaluate/accept loop inspired by BetterHarness and AutoSaddler. No claim of exact reproduction; no LLM proposer.
method_notes.sequential_optimizer_choice: Evolutionary search is used because three candidate evaluations per seed are too few for a stable Bayesian surrogate and do not justify training an RL policy.
method_notes.gepa: Optional only; excluded from complete_core unless its target and proposer budgets can be made symmetric without delaying the mandatory matrix.

core_design.optional_extension: 25 search observations and context 4096 only after complete_core

budgets.target_task_evaluations: 30 search plus 10 validation per method and algorithm seed
budgets.reason_for_small_candidate_count: A symmetric complete matrix is prioritized over the recommended 25 candidate evaluations; this is preregistered, not a post-result reduction.

objectives.tail: 0.5 * mean_reward + 0.5 * mean of worst ceil(0.20*n) task rewards
objectives.tail_small_n_rule: Use at least one task; for n=10 use the two lowest rewards.

finalist_rule: Freeze the highest search objective genome for each method/seed. Compare on validation without updates. Overall finalists are the top two methods by mean validation reward averaged over algorithm seeds; ties break by success, then fewer tokens, then genome hash.
early_stopping: No statistical early stop inside complete_core. Stop only for exhausted task budget, three consecutive infrastructure failures, or unavailable required model.
infrastructure_errors: Log separately; do not score as task failure; retry up to two times, then stop the run resumably without consuming the task-evaluation budget.

confidence_intervals.task_bootstrap: 95% percentile bootstrap over task ids, 10000 resamples, seed 20261009
confidence_intervals.algorithm_randomness: Report percentile interval over the three algorithm seeds separately; never call it a task-generalization CI.

feature_fitting: No learned feature encoder is used. Any future encoder vocabulary, normalization, or statistics must be fit on search only.
leakage_policy: Model messages may contain only public task fields and generic verifier errors. Never log or send reference_sql, hidden tests, or private answers.
held_out_policy: Do not open held-out in this exploratory run unless algorithms and finalist hashes are frozen and validation power is judged sufficient. The default is to leave it closed.
